newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up as select blue chips rise.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up as select blue chips rise.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Friday as select blue chips rose on speculative buying before the Saturday-Sunday weekend and will gain further in the next trading week on technicals, dealers said.

The index at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) finished higher "mainly on speculative buying of blue chips as the current levels were attractive, but overall sentiment was mixed ahead of the weekend", a dealer said. "The index is likely to rise next week on a technical rally."
The KSE's 100-share index rose 16.14 points, or 1.06 percent, to end at 1,537.51. Losers led gainers 127 to 94.
